description: This PHP source file defines the ViewHistory class for the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder module. It handles displaying a hierarchical tree view of modules, specifically generating a JSON-encoded structure representing the modules for the user interface. The file includes class definitions, method implementations for module title parameters, display logic, and a stub for building nodes from module data.

classes.name: ViewHistory
classes.description: A view class within SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder responsible for displaying a module tree structure in the UI.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns an array of parameters for the module's title, including localized module name and module title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Loads module data, constructs a hierarchical node tree, encodes it as JSON, and outputs it.

methods.name: buildStudioNode
methods.description: Stub method intended to build a tree node from a StudioModule object.
